AC-0051 — pixel-art item icons (all items) + voxel 3D held tools

Fixes the two user-reported bugs: "axe (and tools) have no icon" and "does not look like I'm swinging my axe/pickaxe". Godot-only; web rebuilt.

What changed (file:line)

Part A — item pixel icons

FileLinesChange
godot/core/atlas.gd6, 36-83, 120-127, 213-220, 222-262new IDIR item-texture dir prefix + IMAP (47 data.gd item ids → mcpack texture name); _import_core now also builds the item atlas via new _import_items(z); _save_pack writes assets/items_atlas.{png,json}. Single-sprite-per-item, 32×32 tiles, missing texture = flat-color fallback (never crash).
godot/autoload/data.gd30-31, 187, 191-206, 251-263loads items_atlas.{png,json} into item_atlas_tex/item_atlas_rects in _ready; item_rect(id) (single source-of-truth lookup), item_tint(id), apply_items_atlas() (runtime re-import).
godot/ui/inventory.gd219, 459-468, 471-490, 666_item_texture(id) caches an ImageTexture cropped from the item atlas; _setup_icon now draws the atlas tile for items (else flat fallback) — fixes E-inv, storage, hotbar, armor AND the left Craftable list in one place.
godot/ui/menu.gd163-174runtime pack import also applies the item atlas (apply_items_atlas) and reports item count.
godot/player/player.gd64, 66, 404-421, 1065held non-tool items now use a textured sprite (_item_atlas_tex(id)) instead of the flat _tint_tex billboard; same quad size/position; fallback flat color if no tile. refresh_held clears the item-tex cache.

Part B — voxel 3D held tools

FileLinesChange
godot/player/player.gd60-72, 372-378, 389-420, 456-534new held_tool Node3D parented to hand_root (sibling of held_box/sprite/fist) so the existing swing anim drives it for free. _setup_held_tool rebuilds a per-type voxel model from plain BoxMeshes (1 voxel = 1×1×1 at 0.12 scale): handle = 3 vertical voxels (wood-brown); pick head = 3 voxels across the top; axe head = 2 voxels (top + +x); shovel head = 1 wide voxel at the bottom; sword = vertical 3-voxel with bottom 2 handle-tinted, top tier-tinted. Head/blade tinted per tier via items[id]["icon"]. Static 45° pose (TOOL_POSE_ROT/POS) sits bottom-right. _update_held routes: tool→voxel, block→held_box, non-tool item→textured sprite, empty→fist (reuses the existing _held_key change mechanism, so hotbar switching updates tier/type live). held_head_color() for the harness.

Atlas coverage

data.gd defines items 100–125, 127–138, 139–147 (id 126 flint&steel is reserved, has no entry). 47/47 (100%) map to a Faithful pack texture — wooden/stone/iron/diamond × pickaxe/axe/shovel/sword, iron_sword (109), stick, leather, iron_ingot, coal, diamond, wheat_seeds, raw_iron, meat (beef + cooked), wool→white_wool (block texture), leather/iron/diamond × helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots, bucket/water_bucket/lava_bucket, bow, arrow, bone, string, chicken/cooked_chicken. Import reported item_tiles=47, item_missing=[]. No fallbacks needed (all textures present in the pack).

Bow (142) = icon-only, by design

The bow has no 3D voxel model — it uses the textured pixel-art icon sprite (like other non-tool items). This is intentional: MC's first-person bow model is a complex curved draw-string mesh that does not reduce to a few voxels, and the bow-draw/release behavior is M10 scope. The bow does swing via the existing hand_root anim and shows a proper "Bow" icon in the UI (see spec Part B).

Render set (all first-person, AWECRAFT_NO_FOG=1, R=2)

Each tool reads as a recognizable voxel tool sitting in the bottom-right, tinted per tier, and inherits the 0.1s swing.
